prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one HD full-body sprite for a Mass Effect 2D fighting-game annex.
Reference image: the supplied BIOWARE Mass Effect 3 Marauder model turnaround from its character artist Rion Swanson. All five figures in it are different angles of the SAME design. Generate one figure only.
Subject: a Reaper Marauder from MASS EFFECT 3, based precisely on the textured model in the reference. Preserve its tall lean turian body, native bent turian leg structure and clawed feet; weathered oxidized steel-grey armor, rib-cage chest frame with orange-red inner material, shoulder shells with circular mechanical sockets, circular elbow and knee fittings, numerous dark ribbed cables flowing from the neck down the back and into the waist. Reproduce the distinctive narrow turian skull/face frame, paired swept-back cranial blades and little round white-blue optical lenses; keep the exact reference head profile, not a human skull or a fantasy demon.
Pose/view: one full body in a controlled idle combat stance facing screen-right in three-quarter side view. Empty hands slightly forward, no invented rifle or blade. Preserve the asymmetries and panel arrangement visible in the turnaround. Keep intact body materials as shown, no new injury, no scene of violence.
Style: faithful realistic HD pre-rendered game asset with fine mechanical detail, restrained studio lighting from upper left, clear silhouette, same proportions and color distribution as the original model, no chibi or exaggerated redesign.
Framing/output: portrait composition with the ENTIRE subject visible from cranial blades to claws, at least five percent blank margin above and below and around hands. Actual transparent background with a clean alpha edge. No floor or ground shadow, backdrop, glow cloud, text, logos, interface, labels, collage or multiple views. One character per image.
